direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum and no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow animation while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right, large header tabs spanning most of the header; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; depth via layered machine silhouettes, floor perspective and emerald flow along feasible routes only

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and refit station and job boxes into a layered cinematic SVG with floor depth and emerald flow, reducing the large empty lower areas inside boxes.
Raise rail labels and secondary station text toward 16px body where space allows, keeping the compact horizontal rail equal-width and non-wrapping at 1366x768.
Add a persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, cross marker and text inside the scene reserved zone.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% of main and give verified findings a stronger emerald state glow on the exact Certificate, Receiving and substitute nodes they prove.
Keep connection readiness for provider identity visually separate from the investigation evidence task if either control appears, with distinct headings, status and controls.
Tighten the right zone so the 3/0/3 metrics and findings fit without crowding, retaining 16px body and one primary action.
Make path selection in the side zone highlight the matching route and option strip in the SVG bidirectionally, with emerald feasible flow and silver idle depth.
Increase comparison row text and Select this path targets for clarity while preserving the pre-selection state; after selection show one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall.
Reduce empty vertical space inside station and job panels by scaling the cinematic scene rather than stretching flat boxes.
Add a visible route trace from RECEIVING through CELL-MILL-1 to the proposed tasks so the board reads as living factory flow, not only cards.
Keep dashed proposed tasks clearly untracked until approval and strengthen the distinction between proposed, ready and awaiting-approval states with text plus glow.
Enlarge task titles toward 18px and due labels toward 16px inside their reserved zones to match body scale.
Keep the strong preview impact but label CELL-MILL-2 preview explicitly as PREVIEW OFFLINE with silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain text until applied.
Animate the 24h to 0h change as a single cinematic state transition on apply, then settle static, with the same transition removed under reduced motion.
Raise right-zone body copy to a consistent 16px and keep the machine selector at least 36px tall with a visible focus ring.
Correct CELL-MILL-2 to silver cross-hatching, a clear cross marker and plain OFFLINE text with no route through it, replacing the large diagonal cross lines that read as decoration.
Fill the empty right evidence zone with the reinvestigation status or collapse it into the reserved zone so the scene can reach 70% of main.
Show 3 to 2 feasible paths as an emerald route change in the SVG, with Split marked constrained in both scene and side zone.
Apply the same silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE treatment to the constrained Split path and CELL-MILL-2, with matching legend entries.
Make selecting a revised path glow its feasible SVG route and dim non-feasible routes in silver, preparing one-click Approve followed by the authorization wall.
Enlarge the scene depth and flow treatment to reduce flat empty job panels while keeping callouts, stations and jobs in separate reserved zones.
Visually separate the 3 blocked prior tasks from the 3 proposed replacements while showing both coexisting with the approved revised plan, using labelled groups and text states.
Show CELL-MILL-2 as OFFLINE with silver cross-hatching and cross marker in the top station row, consistent with steps 6 and 7.
Add an emerald completion trace from CELL-MILL-1 through t1 to t3 so the replan retains living material flow and depth.
Give the 18-event chain a cinematic emerald trace across 01 to 03 with state glow on READY and silver locked depth on later stages, completing as verification advances.
Reduce dense right-zone instructional text to one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per stage, keeping passphrase guidance at 16px.
Increase the three proof panels' material presence with layered silver surfaces so the finale matches the factory scene visual weight.

Strengthen living flow by showing emerald material movement only along the feasible reroute between running mills and lathes, with silver cross-hatching, cross markers and plain OFFLINE text on every stopped machine.
Fix clipped OFFLINE labels at department bottoms by keeping counts inside each department reserved zone at 1366x768.
Make department and machine focus targets keyboard-visible with a 2px emerald focus ring and bidirectional highlighting to the metrics header.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual or its caption metrics so judges can read department OFFLINE and running counts without zooming, preserving the required presentation order.
Add one concise outcome metric line near the Live demo link, such as 70 parts at risk recovered in 35h versus 83h, using only claims already shown in the product.
Increase contrast and size of the cascade caption and partner role text for faster scanning, keeping the official logo placement and required order unchanged.
